meta.name: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
meta.description: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

videos.title: “Some would say he's a genius”
videos.overview: A fried chicken joint with big ambitions and a new restaurant in a subway station aim to impress the secret inspectors.

videos.title: “Bleeding cash”
videos.overview: After the Stars are revealed in New York, Michelin heads to Chicago where a new Mexican-inspired opening needs a Star to survive.

videos.title: “I love watching a train wreck”
videos.overview: A husband and wife duo pursuing their second Star are confronted with staffing issues. Stars are awarded at the glitzy Chicago ceremony.

videos.title: “Plates, plates, plates”
videos.overview: A renowned chef aims for a second Star deep in the Swedish woods. In Copenhagen, a man with an unlikely past seeks perfection: three Stars.

videos.title: “Maybe I'm an inspector”
videos.overview: In the UK and Ireland, an ambitious chef with a rookie team shoots for his second Star and the daughter of cooking royalty goes it alone.

videos.title: “This is fast-food Michelin”
videos.overview: When Michelin comes to Mexico for the very first time, two friends with restaurants try to impress the inspectors in their own unique ways.

videos.title: “Welcome to hell”
videos.overview: In Italy, a two-Star chef goes for a third with the world's tiniest ravioli. A family-owned restaurant needs a Star to bring visitors to the countryside.

videos.title: “A thousand little things done perfectly”
videos.overview: A chef in California tries to win back a Star he lost. A new chef in a strip mall shoots for two Stars under the eye of a demanding boss.

videos.title: “Dare to be different”
videos.overview: The UK's priciest restaurant chases a third Star—and finds itself caught in an international media storm.

videos.title: “There is no plan B”
videos.overview: In Miami, an Ecuadorian chef's tiny kitchen seeks its first Star, but a staff exit threatens her chances.

videos.title: “Could you imagine losing one?”
videos.overview: As Florida's Michelin race comes to a close, a passionate chef risks losing his hard-won Star.

videos.title: “We could make history!”
videos.overview: A São Paulo couple dreams of Latin America's first three-Star title. A Rio chef and son compete for glory.

videos.title: “To cook is to dance with the fire”
videos.overview: A young Parisian chef hopes to earn a second Star while a couple risks it all on a Burgundy dream.

videos.title: “Michelin is like the girlfriend you can never get”
videos.overview: In Stockholm, a duo sacrifices their Star to build a new restaurant. A chef hunts new flavors in Lapland.

videos.title: “We do it MY way”
videos.overview: A chef battles a staffing crisis while pursuing a third Star as a Berlin visionary seeks his second.

videos.title: “We don't compromise”
videos.overview: In San Francisco, a couple champions Filipino cuisine. A former cyclist sprints for a Star.
